root_cause.text: The function `create_securityfs_measurement_lists()` uses the `crypto_id` field (which can be `HASH_ALGO__LAST` for unsupported TPM algorithms) as an unchecked index into the `hash_algo_name[]` array, causing an out-of-bounds read when the TPM bank algorithm is not in the supported list.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "ima_tpm_chip->allocated_banks[i].crypto_id is initialized to HASH_ALGO__LAST if the TPM algorithm is not supported. However there are places relying on the algorithm to be valid because it is accessed by hash_algo_name[]." The KASAN report confirms a global-out-of-bounds at `create_securityfs_measurement_lists+0x396/0x440` reading `hash_algo_name[algo]` when `algo` is `HASH_ALGO__LAST`. The patch introduces a check for `HASH_ALGO__LAST` and avoids the out-of-bounds access by constructing a fallback file name.
